resources.string: Your AI stylist for the wardrobe you already own. Snap your clothes, get outfit ideas, try them on, and pack for trips — all kept private in your own Google Drive.
Photograph each item once. AI removes the background and tags the type, colour, material and more, so everything stays searchable.
Get outfit suggestions tailored to the weather, the occasion and your taste — built only from clothes you actually own.
Add a photo of yourself and see any outfit rendered on you before you wear it. Tap the centre button any time to start a try-on.
Tell the travel planner where you\'re going and for how long. It builds a day-by-day capsule wardrobe from your closet.
Save items you\'re considering and let the shopping helper check whether they match what you already own — and fill real gaps.
This helps the AI tailor every suggestion to you. You can change it any time in Settings.
A full-body, front-facing photo lets you try outfits on yourself. Optional — you can add it later.
Connect to the internet to add your photo.
Your first closet is ready. Add a few clothes to get your first outfit ideas — or explore first and add them whenever you like.
LibreLookAI runs on Google Gemini using your own API key. It is stored only on this device and used directly with Google — nothing passes through our servers.

A free key already covers tagging and outfit suggestions. Virtual try-on and background removal generate images, which needs a billing-enabled (paid) key — Google still only charges for what you actually use.
Connect to the internet to open Google AI Studio. You can still paste a key you already have.

LibreLookAI keeps everything — your clothes, outfits and photos — in a private folder in your own Google Drive. Nothing is stored on our servers, and only you can see it. Sign in with Google to create your wardrobe.
Connect to the internet to sign in with Google.

Importing photos, removing backgrounds and tagging clothes with AI can take a little while. LibreLookAI needs unrestricted background processing so Android doesn\'t kill it mid-task — which could otherwise leave half-imported items, missing tags or corrupted files.\n\nThis only allows the app to finish work you started; it does not run anything on its own.

LibreLookAI uses your approximate location to look up local weather, so it can suggest outfits that suit the day\'s conditions. Your location stays on your device and is only used to fetch the weather — it is never stored or shared. You can skip this and enable it later.
